info.title: Showpass Organizer Discounts API
info.description: List, retrieve, create, update and remove discounts using scoped organizer API keys.

get.description: Requires a key bound to this organization and an employee with Manage Events or All Access. Usage statistics can be cached for up to ten minutes. Search by code or description. The default order is descending discount ID. Buy/Get discounts use the common list fields. Retrieve one by ID for the Buy/Get rule.

post.description: Requires a key bound to this organization and an employee with Manage Events or All Access. Creates the discount synchronously. Codes are normalized and unique to the organization. For Buy/Get, send type 9, a complete rule and eligible reward ticket types from the same event as the qualifying types. Buy/Get is automatic by default. Use CODE activation for a customer-entered code. Auto discounts require venue eligibility, capacity and discount rules. Check by code or list results before retrying a create after an uncertain result.

put.description: Requires a key bound to this organization and an employee with Manage Events or All Access. Updates the discount synchronously. The existing discount type is retained. An omitted Buy/Get rule keeps the existing rule. Once used in a sale, pricing, qualifying items, reward items and activation mode can be locked. Check the saved discount before retrying.

ApplyMethodEnum.description:
* `1` - Apply to each item individually
* `2` - Single application to entire basket

LimitTypeEnum.description:
* `1` - Item quantity
* `2` - Total basket quantity
* `3` - Total purchase amount

PermissionTypeEnum.description:
* `disc_level_venue` - Apply to all items of this type
* `disc_level_ticket_type` - Apply to certain items of this type
* `disc_level_excluded_ticket_type` - Exclude certain items of this type
* `disc_level_all` - Allowed to be used to all items of this type
